intro: The Jade Phial is a specially crafted vessel provided by the night elf druid Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar. It is designed to safely draw and transport sacred water from Teldrassil's moonwells to replenish the druids' central well in Darnassus.

p: Teldrassil is dotted with moonwells that channel lunar and natural energies vital to night elf society and druidic worship. As part of maintaining this harmony, the central moonwell used by the druids in Darnassus must periodically be replenished from the outlying wells across the great bough. Corithras Moonrage entrusts young initiates with the Jade Phial, a receptacle carefully prepared to gather pure waters from the moonwell near Starbreeze Village without disturbing its delicate spiritual potency.
